# Ember & Olive
> Wood-Fired Mediterranean Cuisine & Seasonal Cellar in Downtown Seattle.

- Location: 418 Olive Way, Seattle, WA 98101
- Telephone: (206) 555-0194
- Email: hospitality@emberandolive.com
- Service Hours:
  - Lunch: Tuesday - Sunday, 12:00 PM - 2:30 PM
  - Dinner: Tuesday - Sunday, 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM
  - Mondays: Closed for hearth maintenance & foraging
- Cuisine: Wood-fired Mediterranean, seasonal Pacific Northwest ingredients, biodynamic and low-intervention natural wines.
- Dietary Options: Gluten-Free (GF), Vegetarian (V), Vegan (VG), Dairy-Free (DF), Nut-Conscious (N).
- Reservations: Available online up to 90 days in advance; phone inquiries required for parties of 8+.
